versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.startupSource:
10 CLS
20 INPUT"DO YOU WHAT   1) EQUATION BALANCE
              2) ORDERED PAIRS
              ";C
30 CLS
40 IF C=2 THEN 5000 ELSEIFC=1THEN90 ELSE PRINT"TYPE EITHER   1   OR  2 ":GOTO20
80  REM EQUATION BALANCE
90 NC=-1
100 FOR X=1TO40:SET(X+10,24):SET(X+80,24):NEXTX
110 FORX=30TO100:SET(X,32):SET(X,31):NEXTX
120 FOR Y=25TO30:SET(30,Y):SET(100,Y):NEXTY
130 FOR X=62TO68:FORY=33TO35:SET(X,Y):NEXTY,X
